_doc: Materials for PTCryspMC. density [g/cm^3]; components = element mass fractions (informational); xcom = NIST XCOM mass-attenuation table [cm^2/g], path relative to data/. Transport uses incoherent + photoelectric + pair channels: Sigma = (mu/rho) * density. Scintillators also carry, keyed to the crystal name: light_yield_per_MeV [photons/MeV], scint_decay_ns + scint_decay_w (decay-component lifetimes [ns] and weights summing to 1), eres_a (fractional energy-resolution FWHM at 511 keV), pde (effective photon-detection efficiency for the crystal emission spectrum), sigma_t_ns (per-gamma Gaussian readout timing floor: trigger/threshold + SPTR + optics, calibrated so the simulated CTR matches measurement — CsI anchored to Soleti et al. 2024 scaled to this PDE; BGO to the ~5 ns window of commercial BGO systems).

G4_BRAIN_ICRP._note: ICRP brain, the ptcrysp head-phantom medium; name matches phantom_regions.csv for direct lookup

BGO_195K._note: BGO at 195 K (dry ice). Faster single-component decay, lower yield than 77 K.

BGO_77K._note: BGO at 77 K (liquid nitrogen). Two decay components; highest yield.

Air._note: no xcom: treated as non-interacting (straight-line propagation)
